regressions.bug: GET /api/env-status returned 404 — frontend called /api/env-status but only /api/env existed
regressions.fix: Added /api/env-status alias route in main.py
regressions.assertion: GET /api/env-status returns 200

regressions.bug: POST /api/schedule/config returned 405 — Save Schedule button in dashboard did nothing
regressions.fix: Added POST /api/schedule/config handler
regressions.assertion: POST /api/schedule/config with valid body returns 200

regressions.bug: GET /api/schedule/suggest returned 404 — Suggest Times button was broken
regressions.fix: Added GET /api/schedule/suggest endpoint
regressions.assertion: GET /api/schedule/suggest returns 200 with suggestedTimes field

regressions.bug: POST /api/network/test returned 405 — frontend sends POST, backend was GET-only
regressions.fix: Added @app.post decorator alongside @app.get on network_test handler
regressions.assertion: POST /api/network/test returns non-5xx

regressions.bug: POST /api/circuit-breakers/all/reset returned 404 — {name} wildcard caught 'all' before specific route
regressions.fix: Added explicit /all/reset alias and reordered routes before {name}/reset wildcard
regressions.assertion: POST /api/circuit-breakers/all/reset returns 200

regressions.bug: seoMinScore was sent by frontend but not in DEFAULTS — reset to undefined on reload
regressions.fix: Added seoMinScore: 50 to DEFAULTS in settings.py
regressions.assertion: GET /api/settings response includes seoMinScore key

regressions.bug: bskyEnabled not in DEFAULTS — response shape was unstable across fresh sessions
regressions.fix: Added bskyEnabled: True to DEFAULTS in settings.py
regressions.assertion: GET /api/settings response includes bskyEnabled key

regressions.bug: GET /api/schedule/config only returned cron+nextRun+paused — frontend also reads schedulerEnabled, postsPerDay, postingHours
regressions.fix: Enriched schedule_config() to include those fields from settings
regressions.assertion: GET /api/schedule/config includes schedulerEnabled, postsPerDay, postingHours

regressions.bug: POST /api/settings accepted any value — negative cost cap, zero postsPerDay, string maxPostLength all silently persisted
regressions.fix: Added _SETTINGS_VALIDATORS dict and _validate_settings() in main.py
regressions.assertion: POST /api/settings with negative dailyCostCap returns ok=false

regressions.bug: postingHours regex accepted '25-99' — hours outside 0-23 were silently stored
regressions.fix: Added range check: 0 <= hour <= 23 after regex match
regressions.assertion: POST /api/settings with postingHours '25-99' returns ok=false

regressions.bug: X Twitter 403 (wrong OAuth permissions) raised RuntimeError which tripped the circuit breaker, halting all subsequent posts
regressions.fix: Added AuthError class to circuit_breaker.py; call() skips failure counting for AuthError
regressions.assertion: AuthError raised inside circuit breaker call() does not increment failure counter

regressions.bug: _get_registered_routes used dict assignment so POST overwrote GET for dual-method routes; test falsely reported GET /api/settings as missing
regressions.fix: Changed to routes.setdefault(path, set()).update(methods)
regressions.assertion: Routes with both GET and POST show both methods in registry

regressions.bug: X, Facebook, Instagram credentials disappeared after page refresh — not persisted to social-connections.json
regressions.fix: Store credentials to social-connections.json on save
regressions.assertion: GET /api/accounts returns connected field for social platforms

regressions.bug: POST /api/social/x/credentials, /facebook/credentials, /instagram/credentials returned 404 — dashboard Save button silently dropped all X/Facebook/Instagram credentials
regressions.fix: Added four credential save routes in main.py; Bluesky client now reads from social-connections.json as fallback when env vars not set
regressions.assertion: POST /api/social/x/credentials with handle returns ok=true

regressions.bug: Dedup TTL was 168h — all products blocked for a week, SLO collapsed to 58%
regressions.fix: Reduced dedup TTL to 24h
regressions.assertion: GET /api/dedup/stats returns ttlHours <= 48

regressions.bug: Server crashed on startup when BSKY_HANDLE/BSKY_APP_PASSWORD env vars not set in HF Space
regressions.fix: Made env var loading graceful — missing vars report error in /api/diagnose instead of crashing
regressions.assertion: GET /api/health returns 200 even without BSKY_HANDLE set

regressions.bug: Admitad XML feed URLs contained & — affiliate links were broken in posts
regressions.fix: Added html.unescape() when parsing XML feed URLs
regressions.assertion: pipeline handles HTML entities in product URLs

regressions.bug: Caption described product from network A but deeplink pointed to network B — misleading posts
regressions.fix: Ensured caption and deeplink always come from the same product source
regressions.assertion: POST /api/run returns consistent product source for caption and deeplink

regressions.bug: Bluesky OAuth opened in same iframe — blocked by HuggingFace iframe sandbox
regressions.fix: Added target=_blank to OAuth link so it opens in new tab
regressions.assertion: GET /api/accounts does not crash — bluesky auth flow reachable

regressions.bug: createSession called on every pipeline run — hit Bluesky rate limit (30/5min)
regressions.fix: Persist Bluesky session to disk, reuse until expired
regressions.assertion: Repeated POST /api/run calls don't hammer Bluesky auth

regressions.bug: AliExpress affiliate links led to blank screen — triple-layer redirect chain was broken
regressions.fix: Keep deep_link.htm path, clean dl_target_url parameter
regressions.assertion: AliExpress product URLs contain proper tracking parameters

regressions.bug: Pipeline sometimes posted plain (non-affiliate) Amazon URLs — zero revenue
regressions.fix: Added guard: never post if deeplink == original URL without monetization
regressions.assertion: GET /api/status shows source-tracked product in lastRun

regressions.bug: NameError: json not imported in main.py — _load_social_connections and _save_social_connections crashed on every call because json was only imported locally as _json in middleware
regressions.fix: Added import json at top of main.py
regressions.assertion: POST /api/social/bluesky/credentials returns ok=true

regressions.bug: save_bluesky_credentials assigned handle twice — first line set handle from body.get('handle') or body.get('password'), second line immediately overwrote it with body.get('handle') only, making first assignment dead code
regressions.fix: Removed dead first assignment
regressions.assertion: POST /api/social/bluesky/credentials with handle+password returns ok=true

regressions.bug: Facebook/Instagram/Tumblr raised RuntimeError on 401/403 (expired token), incorrectly incrementing circuit breaker failure counter and eventually halting all posts to those platforms
regressions.fix: Changed 401/403 responses in _post_facebook, _post_instagram, _post_tumblr to raise AuthError (which circuit breaker skips for failure counting)
regressions.assertion: AuthError raised inside circuit breaker call() does not increment failure counter

regressions.bug: pipeline.py Bluesky except RuntimeError block checked 'rate' in str(e) to detect rate limits — AuthError (subclass of RuntimeError) could have been caught there and auto-paused the pipeline as if rate-limited
regressions.fix: Added explicit except AuthError handler before except RuntimeError in pipeline Bluesky block
regressions.assertion: AuthError from Bluesky does not set pipeline STATE['paused']

regressions.bug: Groq/Mistral generated Arabic-language captions when product names/descriptions were in Arabic — captions rejected as unusable, wasting AI budget on every run
regressions.fix: Prepend 'You must respond in English only' to every system prompt; added Arabic Unicode range check to _looks_usable()
regressions.assertion: AI caption for Arabic product name is in English
